extension.summary: Widgets and lists from your self-hosted Floppy tracker
extension.description: Browse your Floppy (self-hosted media tracker) library from Kodi: Continue Watching, Next Up, Top Picks, Trending, watchlists, history, calendar and your own lists. Every category can be used as a skin widget. Items play through any player add-on you configure, and resume positions are saved back to Floppy.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Settings, Integrations, API Token).
extension.news: 1.3.0: No longer needs TMDb Helper: play through any add-on with a plugin path (browse add-ons or pick a TMDb Helper-style player file) or a custom URL, with TMDb Helper placeholders and encodings. Playback started outside Floppy, such as from a skin, is tracked and resumed too. Search results carry full tracked state, anime included. Episode lists fill missing plots, runtimes and stills from TMDb. Skins get watchlist status and the show's IMDb id on episodes. Widgets refresh only when Floppy data changes, unless Refresh widgets automatically is on. Playback settings changed: choose your player again under Playback.
